Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final analysis step (Step 10), the Planner incorrectly interpreted conflicting birth dates for Julia Crawford Ivers. The search results showed dates of 1867 and 1869. The Planner erroneously stated, "standardized to 1967 using two-digit year normalization," changing the year from the 19th century (1800s) to the 20th century (1900s). This fabrication of data led to the false conclusion that Julia Crawford Ivers (born ~1867) was born after T. V. Chandran (born 1950), whereas historically, the director of *The Majesty of the Law* was actually born much earlier. The correct answer should have been *Bhoomiyude Avakashikal* because T. V. Chandran (1950) was born later than Julia Crawford Ivers (1867/1869).
